words.example: Above-average polish still fails if the hole is off center.
words.exampleZh: 孔偏了，拋光再好於平均也過不了。
words.notes: 連字號要保留。只說比一般好，不是完美。

words.example: Hardness is the attribute buyers actually measure.
words.exampleZh: 硬度才是買方真正會量的屬性。
words.notes: attribute A to B 是把 A 歸因於 B。

words.example: A faint blemish on the face is enough to hold the panel.
words.exampleZh: 面板正面有一點瑕疵就先扣下來。
words.notes: 名詞是瑕疵。動詞是弄髒、玷污。

words.example: Breakable gauges ride in a padded case, not in the tool bag.
words.exampleZh: 易碎量具放有襯墊的盒子，不放工具袋。
words.notes: 指容易打破。破碎這個名詞是 breakage。

words.example: A bubble under the paint means the metal was still wet.
words.exampleZh: 漆面底下有氣泡，表示金屬當時還是濕的。
words.notes: 品質上多指氣泡。bubble up 是冒出來。

words.example: A dull ring is a characteristic of a cracked casting.
words.exampleZh: 敲起來悶，是鑄件有裂的特徵。
words.notes: be characteristic of 是……的特徵。of 後面接受特徵描述的事物。

words.example: The checker at the end of the line caught the missing screw.
words.exampleZh: 線尾的檢驗員抓到少了一顆螺絲。
words.notes: 負責查看品質的人。

words.example: The audit will coincide with the month-end shipment.
words.exampleZh: 稽核會和月底出貨撞在同一天。
words.notes: 不及物。coincide with 是與……同時，或與……相符。

words.example: The commentary on the drawing says why the edge must stay sharp.
words.exampleZh: 圖上的評註說明邊緣為什麼必須保持銳利。
words.notes: 對某事的說明或評論。複數 commentaries。

words.example: A comparison with last month's lot shows the pits are new.
words.exampleZh: 和上個月那批一比，就知道這些凹坑是新的。
words.notes: by comparison 是相比之下。

words.example: Seal thickness is critical; the label color is not.
words.exampleZh: 密封厚度是關鍵，標籤顏色不是。
words.notes: 可以是決定成敗的，也可以是提出批評的。critical of 是對……不滿。

words.example: One defect in the seal is enough to stop the lot.
words.exampleZh: 密封件有一個缺陷，整批就先停住。
words.notes: zero defect 是零缺點。

words.example: Defective caps are marked red and kept off the good pallet.
words.exampleZh: 不良瓶蓋標成紅色，不放上良品棧板。
words.notes: defective products 是不良品。

words.example: A dense cluster of pits means the rinse tank failed.
words.exampleZh: 凹坑密集成片，表示清洗槽出了問題。
words.notes: 比較級 denser，最高級 densest。也可形容霧或煙很濃。

words.example: Disposable gloves stay outside the paint booth.
words.exampleZh: 拋棄式手套不要帶進烤漆房。
words.notes: 一次性的。修飾收入時，disposable income 是可支配所得。

words.example: We evaluate the supplier on returns, not on the brochure.
words.exampleZh: 我們用退貨來評估供應商，不看型錄。
words.notes: 評定好壞或價值。

words.example: Please examine the threads under a lamp, not only by touch.
words.exampleZh: 請在燈下檢查螺紋，不要只靠摸。
words.notes: examine 是仔細查看。examine on 則是考某人。

words.example: Heat causes expansion, and this slot was cut too tight.
words.exampleZh: 受熱會膨脹，這個槽開得太緊。
words.notes: 體積變大，或規模擴大。動詞是 expand。

words.example: The plant ran an extensive check on every lot from that mill.
words.exampleZh: 工廠對那家鋼廠的每一批都做了全面檢查。
words.notes: 範圍廣。extensive reading 是泛讀。和 widespread（遍布各地）不完全一樣。

words.example: This fabric pills after one wash, so it will not be used for covers.
words.exampleZh: 這塊布洗一次就起毛球，不能拿來做外罩。
words.notes: 布料。knitted fabric 是針織布。

words.example: Operators gave feedback that the new jig pin is hard to seat.
words.exampleZh: 作業員回饋說新的治具銷不好放進去。
words.notes: 把使用後的意見傳回來。可數或不可數都可以。

words.example: The face looks fine, yet a late certificate still draws a fine.
words.exampleZh: 外觀沒問題，但證書晚到還是會被罰款。
words.notes: 形容詞是細的、良好的。名詞和動詞是罰款。比較級 finer，最高級 finest。

words.example: The fineness of this powder decides whether the nozzle will clog.
words.exampleZh: 這批粉末的細度決定噴嘴會不會堵住。
words.notes: 顆粒有多細，或金屬成色。degree of fineness 是細度。

words.example: There is a flaw in the seam, not in the cloth itself.
words.exampleZh: 問題在縫線，不在布本身。
words.notes: 名詞常接 in：a flaw in sth。作動詞是使產生裂縫。

words.example: A flawless lab sample does not mean the whole lot is clean.
words.exampleZh: 實驗室那一件無瑕，不代表整批都乾淨。
words.notes: 沒有缺點。

words.example: They forge the blade on site, and a forged stamp still fails the audit.
words.exampleZh: 刀片在廠內鍛造；檢驗章若是偽造的，稽核一樣不會過。
words.notes: 鍛造金屬，或偽造文件、印章。名詞 forgery 是偽造品。

words.example: The cover is frangible on purpose, so a jam breaks the cover and not the gear.
words.exampleZh: 外罩故意做成易碎的，卡住時先破外罩，不傷齒輪。
words.notes: 受到撞擊就碎。和 fragile 接近。

words.example: This station frequently stops for thread breaks.
words.exampleZh: 這個工位常常因為斷線而停。
words.notes: 次數多。frequently asked questions 是常見問題。

words.example: The old lining is friable and sheds dust into the furnace.
words.exampleZh: 舊爐襯一碰就碎，粉末會掉進爐裡。
words.notes: 指酥脆、容易捏成碎屑，不是玻璃那種一摔就裂。

words.example: The brochure should not glorify a finish the line cannot hold.
words.exampleZh: 型錄不該美化產線做不到的表面。
words.notes: 說得比實際更好，或大力稱讚。

words.example: A glossy coat shows every wave, so the panel must be flat first.
words.exampleZh: 亮光塗層會把波浪都顯出來，所以板子要先平整。
words.notes: 表面光亮。比較級 glossier。

words.example: This coil is a lower grade than the drawing allows.
words.exampleZh: 這捲材料的等級低於圖面允許的等級。
words.notes: 等級或評分。grade up 是把等級提高。downgrade 是降級。

words.example: Harsh solvent turned the plastic cloudy.
words.exampleZh: 刺激性溶劑把塑膠弄成霧面。
words.notes: 可以形容天氣、條件、聲音或態度。harsh to the ear 是刺耳。

words.example: A second lamp will heighten the chance of seeing a hairline crack.
words.exampleZh: 再加一盞燈，比較看得到髮絲狀裂痕。
words.notes: 使程度變高。heighten awareness of 是提高對……的注意。

words.example: High-quality thread still snaps if the tension is set too high.
words.exampleZh: 張力設太高時，高品質的線一樣會斷。
words.notes: 中間有連字號。of high quality 是品質高。

words.example: One imperfection on the show face rejects the whole panel.
words.exampleZh: 展示面有一個缺點，整片面板就退回。
words.notes: 不完美之處。

words.example: Inferior plating peeled in the first salt-spray hour.
words.exampleZh: 較差的電鍍在鹽霧試驗第一個小時就剝落。
words.notes: be inferior to 是比……差。inferior quality 是低品質。

words.example: An inspector signs the tag only after the gauge reading is written down.
words.exampleZh: 檢驗員先把量具讀數寫下來才簽名。
words.notes: 負責檢查的人。

words.example: We will investigate the scratch before we blame the carrier.
words.exampleZh: 先調查這道刮痕，再決定要不要怪承運商。
words.notes: investigate into 較少用，直接 investigate sth 即可。

words.example: The investigation traced the pits to a dirty rinse tank.
words.exampleZh: 調查把凹坑追到一個髒掉的清洗槽。
words.notes: make an investigation into 是對某事展開調查。

words.example: Each reel is tested in isolation so one bad reel cannot hide.
words.exampleZh: 每一卷分開測，壞的那卷藏不住。
words.notes: in isolation 是單獨地、孤立地。

words.example: Junky cartons are not reused for export.
words.exampleZh: 品質很差的紙箱不拿去裝出口貨。
words.notes: 產線上多指東西破爛、沒有價值。作名詞時另指吸毒者，也可拼 junkie。

words.example: The defect level has to fall before this lot can ship.
words.exampleZh: 不良水準降下來，這一批才能出。
words.notes: 名詞是水準或水平。形容詞是平坦的、同高的。

words.example: The new housing is lightweight, and it still passes the drop check.
words.exampleZh: 新外殼很輕，跌落測試還是過了。
words.notes: 重量輕。說人無足輕重時帶貶義。

words.example: Shipping untested samples would make a mockery of the claim.
words.exampleZh: 沒測過就出樣品，會讓那個保證變成笑話。
words.notes: make a mockery of 是使……顯得荒唐。

words.example: A moderate bake keeps the coating from blistering.
words.exampleZh: 溫度適中的烘烤不會讓塗層起泡。
words.notes: 程度不過高。作動詞是使緩和。be moderate in 是在……方面有節制。

words.example: Brittleness is the nature of this glass, so the pack has to be soft.
words.exampleZh: 這種玻璃本質上脆，包裝必須軟。
words.notes: a nature of 不自然，用 the nature of。

words.example: Guards patrol the yard twice each night.
words.exampleZh: 警衛每晚巡廠區兩次。
words.notes: on patrol 是正在巡邏。

words.example: Premium hose costs more, and the cheap roll split in a week.
words.exampleZh: 高級軟管比較貴；便宜的那捲一個星期就裂了。
words.notes: 形容詞是高品質、高價的。名詞是額外費用。at a premium 是以高價，或稀少。

words.example: Loose parts make scratches prevalent in that bin.
words.exampleZh: 零件在那個箱子裡互相碰撞，刮痕很常見。
words.notes: 某現象到處可見。prevalent trend 是流行趨勢。

words.example: Prevention of rust starts with a dry rack, not with a later polish.
words.exampleZh: 防鏽從乾燥的架子開始，不是等生鏽再拋光。
words.notes: 事先阻止。accident prevention 是事故預防。fire prevention 是防火。

words.example: The engineer stopped the line over a drop in quality.
words.exampleZh: 工程師因為品質下降把線停了。
words.notes: a change in quality 是品質變化。不可數時指品質好壞。

words.example: This oil is highly refined, which is why the residue is so low.
words.exampleZh: 這批油精製程度高，所以殘渣很少。
words.notes: 把雜質去掉，或指舉止高雅。refine on 是再改進，不單獨當字頭。

words.example: The crew resolved the leak by changing the seal.
words.exampleZh: 作業員換了密封件，把滲漏解決了。
words.notes: 動詞是下決心、解決，或使分解。名詞是決心。resolve to do 是決心做。

words.example: Pipes stored in the open will rust within a week.
words.exampleZh: 管子放在戶外，一個星期內就會生鏽。
words.notes: 名詞是鏽。動詞是生鏽。

words.example: A rusty pin throws the hole off center.
words.exampleZh: 銷子生鏽會把孔打偏。
words.notes: 表面有鏽。說技術生疏時，rusty 是荒廢的。

words.example: No rework leaves the cage without the supervisor's sanction.
words.exampleZh: 沒有主管批准，重工品不能離開鐵籠。
words.notes: 可以是批准，也可以是制裁。recognize 和 approve 接近「批准」這個意思。

words.example: Inspectors screen every carton for dents before the tape goes on.
words.exampleZh: 封箱前，檢驗員會把每箱有凹痕的挑出來。
words.notes: screen out 是篩掉。名詞可以指篩子或螢幕。

words.example: A scrupulous checker marks even a faint scratch.
words.exampleZh: 一絲不苟的檢驗員連很淡的刮痕也會標出來。
words.notes: be scrupulous in 是在某事上很審慎。否定是 not scrupulous about，表示不在意。

words.example: Please scrutinize the weld under the lamp, not from the aisle.
words.exampleZh: 請在燈下仔細檢查焊道，不要站在通道遠看。
words.notes: 看得很細。美式拼法 scrutinize，英式常拼 scrutinise。

words.example: The lot stayed on hold until the weld passed scrutiny.
words.exampleZh: 這一批先暫停，等焊道通過仔細檢查。
words.notes: under scrutiny 是正被仔細檢查。

words.example: Shoddy stitching came apart before the carton left the dock.
words.exampleZh: 針線做得很差，紙箱還沒離開碼頭就散了。
words.notes: 品質低劣。fake and shoddy 常連著說偽劣。

words.example: A water stain on the carton is logged, and the carton is replaced.
words.exampleZh: 紙箱上的水漬會登記，紙箱也會換掉。
words.notes: 名詞是污漬。動詞是弄髒，或給木材著色。stain sb's reputation 是玷污名聲。

words.example: The kitchen line runs stainless steel, and the visible edge must stay stainless.
words.exampleZh: 廚具線做的是不鏽鋼，看得到的邊緣也不能有瑕疵。
words.notes: stainless steel 是不鏽鋼。單獨作形容詞時也可以指沒有污點。

words.example: The plant will standardize the torque check on one wrench.
words.exampleZh: 工廠會把扭力檢查統一成同一支扳手。
words.notes: 讓大家用同一套標準。normalize 是使正常化，不是這個字。

words.example: The gap tolerance is strict, and a feeler gauge is required.
words.exampleZh: 間隙公差很嚴，必須用厚薄規。
words.notes: 比較級 stricter，最高級 strictest。be strict with 是對某人嚴格。

words.example: The finish is superb, and it still has to pass the salt spray.
words.exampleZh: 表面極好，鹽霧試驗還是得過。
words.notes: 品質或表現非常好。

words.example: The surveyor rejected the lot because two gauges disagreed.
words.exampleZh: 檢驗員退了這一批，因為兩支量具讀數不一樣。
words.notes: 品質檢驗時指檢查人員。也可指土地勘測員。

words.example: This lot stays put until the hardness test is finished.
words.exampleZh: 硬度測試做完之前，這一批先不要動。
words.notes: 名詞是測試。動詞是進行測試。test out 是加以檢驗。

words.example: This is a trueborn part from our mold, not an outside copy.
words.exampleZh: 這是我們模具做出的正品，不是外面的仿製品。
words.notes: 真正的、名副其實的。

words.example: Ungraded coil cannot be mixed with the certified stock.
words.exampleZh: 還沒分級的鋼捲不能和已認證的料放在一起。
words.notes: 沒有分成等級，或課程不分年級。

words.example: An unidentified powder in the hopper stopped the line.
words.exampleZh: 料斗裡有一種認不出來的粉末，產線因此停下。
words.notes: 後面直接接人或物：unidentified object 是不明物體。

words.example: The first-article report stays valuable after the tool is approved.
words.exampleZh: 模具核准之後，首件報告仍然有用。
words.notes: 值得保留或很重要。

words.example: The handle is wrought, not cast, so the grain follows the curve.
words.exampleZh: 握把是鍛出來的，不是鑄的，所以紋理会沿著弧度走。
words.notes: well-wrought 是做工精細的。wrought iron 是鍛鐵。
